output.answer_markdown: Net cash used in financing activities was smaller in 2020 at $295.6 million [1], compared with $733.6 million in 2019. In 2020 the main uses were share repurchases of $170.7 million, debt repayments of $65.3 million and cash dividends of $130.2 million [2]. In 2019 the main uses were share repurchases of $274.3 million, debt repayments of $310.0 million and cash dividends of $122.4 million [3].
